title: Bunk Johnson leaves; Baby Lovett kept home; Bunk in Alexandria in 1908
summary: Musicians got scared and left on the train, Lovett was fetched back, and Bunk went to Houston; Love dates Bunk in Alexandria to 1908.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. You see, the man just left. They got scared. Yeah. They got on the train. David Lovett was going to leave there too, but Dr. Brown knew them very well, you know, and went and got him. They got his ticket and everything. That was waiting down and said, you can't run off from home like that. You're going to stay home. What was David Lovett from? Bunk left from around Alexander then. He must have come back here. And shortly after that, he went to Houston. Oh Lord. Shortly after that, he went to Houston. I saw him. Uh-uh.

Yeah, I'll get him locked after a while. Where were we then? Bunk left Alexander. He must have come back here, and then he went to Houston. I never heard of him anymore then until I saw him back there in Northern Michigan.
Remember about what year that was when Bunk was up there?
